address: Vicari Joan Marí 14, Es Caló, 07871, Spain
bio: A very pleasant experience and... it overlooks a turquoise sea! Here, under the umbrella of a menu with a good selection of rice dishes and fideuás, they offer a cuisine with a marked Mediterranean flavour, always with interesting daily recommendations. A dish that we liked? Try the Fideuá ciega de pescado, served in a paella pan with cuttlefish, monkfish, scallops, mussels and more....
